claims.claim: Bent office chair available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report describes an office swivel chair with chrome base and 5 caster wheels, but does not show or confirm a bent frame/structure.

risks.risk: Frame may be bent or misaligned (affects comfort, stability, and safety).
risks.proof: One clear side and front shot showing the chair’s backrest alignment and base column straightness (e.g., measure/compare left-right height of armrests/back).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a potentially damaged/possibly bent chair (worst-case: reduced stability/comfort).

risks.risk: Gas lift may be weak or leaking (won’t hold height / drops).
risks.proof: Clip showing the chair raised to a height, then released—confirm it holds without sinking; also show any visible oil/gas residue around the lift.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to hold height (worst-case: treat as faulty gas lift).

risks.risk: Tilt/recline and locking functions may not work.
risks.proof: Short video demonstrating tilt/recline and engaging/disengaging the lock, showing it stays in the selected position.
risks.if_unproven: Price as functions not guaranteed (worst-case: lock/tilt unreliable).

risks.risk: Wheels may not roll smoothly or may have broken casters/brakes.
risks.proof: Clip panning across the floor showing all 5 wheels rolling; if brakes exist, show braking and release.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels/casters may be worn or partially faulty.

risks.risk: Hidden damage under the seat/base (cracks, loose screws, bent frame).
risks.proof: Photo/clip from underneath the seat and around the base showing the underside frame, fasteners, and any cracks/bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown underside condition (worst-case: possible structural issues).

risks.risk: Upholstery condition may be worse than it appears (stains/odor/tears not visible from the angle).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seat and back from multiple angles (front, side, and underside edges) plus a quick wipe test; ask for smell/cleanliness check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as light-wear only but assume possible hidden stains/soiling not fully confirmed.

risks.risk: Armrests may be damaged or non-adjustable (height/angle issues).
risks.proof: Video showing armrests moving through any adjustment range and confirming they lock firmly; close-up of adjustment mechanisms.
risks.if_unproven: Price as armrests condition/adjustability not guaranteed.

proof_requests: Side-by-side front and side photos to confirm whether the chair frame/backrest is actually bent or misaligned.
Video showing gas lift holding height (raise to a set height, release, confirm no sinking).
Video demonstrating tilt/recline and the locking function working and holding position.
Video showing all 5 wheels rolling smoothly; show any brakes if present.
Photos/clip from underneath the seat/base showing the underside frame and fasteners (no cracks/loose parts).
Close-up photos of upholstery from multiple angles (including edges/underside) to check for stains, odors, or tears.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as an office swivel chair and describes visible wear, but key safety/function checks are not shown; pricing should assume worst-case for unverified mechanical condition while treating the “bent” claim as unverified.
